content: Hino, maalongo bhangu muuhaghulitwe na Chgapanga, ngati muulilungite na lukemo lwa kunani kwa Chgapanga, munhwachile muno Yesu, Nndumila na Ndundame Nkulu ghwa uhyubhalilo ghutuukambuka,
ywombe kakibhegha nhyubhaliko kwa ywakanhaghulite, handa Musa pakabheghite nhyubhaliko bhandu bha Isilaeli bhene ndo kitutubhi kya Chgapanga.
Peni Yesu kangunoghwa uhokamo nkulu kuchweha kwa Musa, kiyaha yunakuchenga kitutubhi pakapeghwa uhokamo kyanalumu kupitingana kwa kitutubhi kyene.
Kila kitutubhi kinguchengwa na mundu, peni Chgapanga ndo nchenga ghwa hilibhi hyoha.
Musa kakibhegha nndumitumi ghwa kuhyubhalika mu bhandu bha kitutubhi kya Akaaisilaeli bhoha, na kakikambuka milando yene Chgapanga katalongela kuulongolo,

peni Kilisito handa Mwana nhyubhaliko ywakaalongoha bhandu bha kitutubhi kya Chgapanga, na twenga ndo bhandu abho mu kitutubhi kya Chgapanga, Handa twaaghendelela kubhegha akangamalo na ahwadali mu milando yila yituyidumbila mbaka ku uhiko.
Hinu, handa pakalongela Nhuki ghwa Chgapanga,

content.text: nkotoke kubhegha na ngakatala, handa abhele bhenu paang'ehite,
Akwo ndo aghohi bhenu bhakibhegha bhangung'eha nenga na kumbima, Chgapanga kangulongela,
hata bhula mu ngungwa mbinda mabhoko ncheche bhakighabhona mandendelo ghangu ghandendite.
Habhu ndo bhandu bhala bhakindenda nyaghabhale na nikilongela,
‘Bhaayingila ng'obhe mu nnima ghwene ndabhapegha apughwe!’”

content: Alongo bhangu, mu mwenga kakotoke kubhegha mundu yuna ngakatala ywangahyubhalila, na ywakalibhaghulite na Chgapanga yunakulama.
Peni nnyonjokehane mwoyo mabhene kwa mabhene manjubha ghoha kila linjubha, ngati kakotoke kubhegha nga yumoo ywenu ywakatenditwe nnonopo kwa ukuluho ghwa ulemwa.
Twenga twaaghendelela kubhegha mukulilunga na Kilisito, handa twaakamulana na udumbilo ghuutubheghite naghwo kutandila mbaka kuuhiko,

content.text: nkotoke kubhegha na ngakatala handa paatendite aghohi bhenu,

content: Ndo aghani abho bhaayihwite lilobhe lya Chgapanga na bhakinkiluka? Ndo bhala bhoha bhaalongohitwe na Musa kukibhala kuhuma ku Misili.
Chgapanga kakiyaghabhihwa na aghani mu ngungwa mbinda mabhoko ncheche? Kakiayaghabhalila bhala bhaatendite ulemwa, mitumba yabhe yikibhegha pilikichi kula kukibhala.
Chgapanga pakalapite “Maayingila ng'obhe pa kupughwa kwa nenga,” kakialapila aghani? Kakibhegha kakilongela kwa kya bhala bha akilukite.
Hino, tungubhona kukita bhakiyingila ng'obhe akwo kwa ghwangahyubhalila kwabhe.
